source: Greg Girard and Ian Lambot, City of Darkness Revisited (Watermark, 2014). Facts, page numbers and short quotes only. Notes: primary-sources/city-of-darkness-revisited/SOURCE.md.
note: Hand-curated. Page numbers are printed pages. Places on the plan come from data/book_overlay.json (tools/book_overlay.py). Interviews are from about 1990: for 1986 they are APPROXIMATE.

buildings1987.quote: some 300 individual buildings, each rising up to a possible 15 storeys

registered1987.note: just over 33,000 after the second day of the registration of 14-15 Jan 1987, with the people who worked in the City but lived elsewhere

standpipes1987.quote: Only one of these was located within the City

wells1987.quote: identified 67 working wells owned by some 40 suppliers

streets.quote: around 30 main streets and alleys, some no more than three feet across

storeys.note: "14 storeys and more by 1972" (p118); "the maximum height of 12, 13 and 14 storeys" (p334); "a possible 15 storeys" (p340)

tcs.name: Tai Chang St 大井街
tcs.note: "Tai Chang (Big Well) Street"; the clearance files use the same name. The 1992 map names two legs: south-west and north-west.

tcn.name: Tai Chang St 大井街
tcn.note: The north-west leg, named on the 1992 map. Premises on Tai Chang St stay on the south-west leg.

abs.name: Almshouse Back St
abs.note: Named on the 1992 map, north of the Yamen. No Chinese name is in hand.

tts.name: Tin Hau Temple St
tts.note: Named on the 1992 map, by the Tin Hau Temple. The files have a 'Tin Hau Temple Back Street' (key tht).

lcb.name: Lung Chun Back Rd
lcb.note: Named on the 1992 map, south of the Yamen. The rubber-plunger workshop (p237) and the Salvation Army kindergarten (p300) were on it.

lanes.note: Numbered lanes in the clearance file titles (data/businesses.json). Their places are not known.
lanes.same: "No 14, 7th Lane, Sai Shing Road" is "also known as" "No 37B, 7th Lane, Tai Chang St." (HKRS1255-3): the 7th Lane joins the two streets.
